scenarios.requirement: A help link of 124 or 200 bytes is followed to its page, whole or refused, and never written past a buffer
scenarios.note: red on 48f1855 under wpe-asan for 124 and 200 (stack-buffer-overflow of str in e_help_ret); the 5 byte case is the control

scenarios.requirement: A help page whose heading line is 200 bytes opens and shows the lines after it
scenarios.note: red on 48f1855 under wpe-asan: heap-buffer-overflow writing the first row

scenarios.requirement: An Info node whose Next: name is 200 bytes opens
scenarios.note: red on 48f1855 under wpe-asan: stack-buffer-overflow of tmp in e_mk_info_pt

scenarios.requirement: Next to an Info node whose name is 122 to 127 bytes opens that node
scenarios.note: red on 48f1855 under wpe-asan: stack-buffer-overflow of fstr in e_read_info

scenarios.requirement: An indirect Info file naming a 200 byte subfile opens the node that subfile holds
scenarios.note: red on 48f1855 under wpe-asan: stack-buffer-overflow of nfl in e_info_jump

scenarios.requirement: The owner writes a token whole or cut at a character, terminated, never past its size, and refuses a mark that does not fit
scenarios.note: red when the character-boundary cut, the cap or the insert refusal is stubbed off

scenarios.requirement: A menu entry linking to a file name over 125 bytes opens that file's node
scenarios.note: red on 48f1855 under wpe-asan: stack-buffer-overflow of str in e_help_ret (HNF)

scenarios.requirement: An Indirect: block with no entries leaves the editor alive
scenarios.note: red on 48f1855 under wpe-asan: heap-buffer-overflow read of the first entry of an empty list

scenarios.requirement: A node header holding a word that starts with Next opens, and Next goes to the next node
scenarios.note: red on 48f1855 by the screen wait: the editor loops in e_mk_info_pt

scenarios.requirement: A man page button whose name is too long to hold whole is refused with a message, and a short button beside it still opens its page
scenarios.note: needs man; red on 48f1855 under wpe-asan for the long button (stack-buffer-overflow of str in e_help_ret, HFB); red when the refusal in e_help_ret is removed; the short button is the control

scenarios.requirement: An indirect Info file whose tag table lists a longer node name first still opens the node asked for
scenarios.note: green on 48f1855; red when the tag line number is read from a row whose name only starts with the one asked for

scenarios.requirement: Following links in the help viewer leaves the graphical editor alive
scenarios.note: alive check; the parse path is shared code with no backend branch

scenarios.requirement: Following links in the help viewer leaves the graphical editor alive
